datasets.name: CC_OutForm
datasets.sql:
select
    commision_trans.Rowid
   ,id
   ,name
   ,debt
   ,sb_complex_transactions.getaccountnumber(debt) as DebitAccount
   ,sb_complex_transactions.GetAccountCurrency(debt) as DebitCurrency
   ,credit
   ,sb_complex_transactions.getaccountnumber(credit) as CreditAccount
   ,sb_complex_transactions.GetAccountCurrency(credit) as CreditCurrency
   ,additionalDebt
   ,additionalCredit
   ,sb_complex_transactions.getaccountnumber(additionalDebt) as ADebt
   ,sb_complex_transactions.GetAccountCurrency(additionalDebt) as ADebitCurrency
   ,sb_complex_transactions.getaccountnumber(additionalCredit) as ACredit
   ,sb_complex_transactions.GetAccountCurrency(additionalCredit) as ACreditCurrency
   ,assignment
   ,commisionassignment
   ,UserID   
from
    commision_trans
where
  
 (credit>0 and  additionalcredit>0 and debt=0 and additionaldebt=0)
  
order by
    commision_trans.ID

datasets.name: CC_InForm
datasets.sql:
select
    commision_trans.*
   ,id
   ,name
   ,debt
   ,sb_complex_transactions.getaccountnumber(debt) as DebitAccount
   ,sb_complex_transactions.GetAccountCurrency(debt) as DebitCurrency
   ,credit
   ,sb_complex_transactions.getaccountnumber(credit) as CreditAccount
   ,sb_complex_transactions.GetAccountCurrency(credit) as CreditCurrency
   ,assignment
   ,UserID
from
    commision_trans
where
   debt>0
order by
    commision_trans.ID

datasets.name: AccStateData
datasets.sql:
select
  arc.DATDATE as ArchiveDate,
  arc.ACC_ID as AccID,
  abs(arc.OSTAT) as Amount,
  abs(arc.POK_OSTAT) as LAmount,
  abs(arc.OBR_D) as DebitTurnover,
  abs(arc.POK_OBR_D) as DebitLTurnover,
  abs(arc.OBR_K) as CreditTurnover,
  abs(arc.POK_OBR_K) as CreditLTurnover
from archost arc
where arc.acc_id = :AccID
order by arc.datdate --desc

datasets.name: DebetTransactionsData
datasets.sql:
select
  p.ID,
  p.debt as DebitAccID,
  p.dat as OperationDate,
  p.ammount as DebitAmount,
  p.ammount_c as CreditAmount,
  p.lammount as LAmount,
  ac.acc_no as CreditAccNo,
  p.NAME as Destination
from
  SMART.provarch p,
  SMART.account ac
where
  (p.dat between :StartDate and :EndDate)
  and (p.debt = :AccountID)
  and (ac.id = p.kredit)
order by p.dat

datasets.name: CreditTransactionsData
datasets.sql:
select
  p.ID,
  p.kredit as CreditAccID,
  p.dat as OperationDate,
  p.ammount as DebitAmount,
  p.ammount_c as CreditAmount,
  p.lammount as LAmount,
  ad.acc_no as DebitAccNo,
  p.NAME as Destination
from
  SMART.provarch p,
  SMART.account ad
where
  (p.kredit = :AccountID)
  and (p.dat between :StartDate and :EndDate)
  and (ad.id = p.debt)
order by p.dat

datasets.name: Credits
datasets.sql:
select cont.id,
       cont.contractno,
       SBCM_CONSTRUCTION.get_credit_customers(cont.clientid) as CustName,
       SBCM_CONSTRUCTION.get_contractaccount(ContAcc.loanaccid) as accno,
       cont.opendate,
       cont.closedate,
       av.val_name,
       cont.creditamount,
       cont.amountflatkv,
       SBCM_CONSTRUCTION.Get_CompanyID(cont.flatid) as companyid,
       SBCM_CONSTRUCTION.Get_BuildingID(cont.flatid) as BuildingID,
       cont.flatid,
       cont.buildingno,
       cont.blokno,
       cont.flatno,
       cont.branchid,
       cont.usid,
       cont.commitcontract as status,
       state.rest,
       SBCM_CONSTRUCTION.get_contractpayments(cont.id) as payamt 
       
from  CONSTUCTION_CONTRACTS_ACTIVE cont ,
      SBCM_CONSTRUCTION_ACCOUNTS  ContAcc,
      CONSTUCTION_curr_state state,
      avalute av
where cont.id = ContAcc.id#
and   Cont.id = state.id#   
and   av.valute = cont.currency     
order by :title
